title: ADJ Alloy Forgery Compatibility Fix
description: Provides better compatibility between Alloy Forgery and EMI in the ADJ modpack.
body:
Made specifically for my upcoming modpack `A Distant Journey`.

I had a problem with the [Alloy Forgery](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alloy-forgery) mod where with [Sinytra Connector](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sinytra-connector) I couldn't override built-in Alloy Forges and their properties. I had to register them through [KubeJS](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/kubejs) using some Java reflection shenanigans, but the forges registered that way didn't show in the EMI recipe category for Alloy Forgery. This mod replaces the AF category with a custom one which adds every item in the tag `#adj:alloy_forge` as a work station.

Made for Fabric, but supposed to be ran using Sinytra Connector.

**Please don't use it in your modpack. This mod was made to fix an issue that was present specifically in my modpack due to how I handled things.** 
If you also need it then sure, you can, but for general modpacks that don't dip into weird shenanigans, **this mod is useless.**
